lead_magnet.title: The 7-Day Money Reset
lead_magnet.headline: Get your money organised in 7 days, 15 minutes a day.
lead_magnet.short: Seven 15-minute tasks, a printable checklist and worksheets. Free.
lead_magnet.pitch: A free 10-page PDF: seven 15-minute tasks that find your real numbers, stop surprise fees, protect your credit and set up a weekly spending number. Printable checklist and worksheets included.
days: Find your real monthly take-home pay and list every fixed bill.
Hunt down forgotten subscriptions and cancel the ones you don't use.
Set three bank alerts that stop overdrafts before they happen.
Open (or check) a separate, insured savings account and automate a first transfer.
Pull your free credit reports, check them like an auditor, and freeze your credit.
Check whether you're getting your full 401(k) match, or note when you'll start.
Set your one weekly spending number and book a 20-minute weekly check-in.

disclaimer: Educational content, not financial, tax or investment advice. Examples are illustrations with assumed numbers, not promises. Check current rules and rates with the official source before acting.
